verdicts.reason: A strands the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow at the bottom left, far below the headline it introduces, and leaves the orange divider floating under the dark logo panel. Its bottom row packs body copy, a small CTA, 'Ships late June' and a tiny column of legal text right up against the headline with no breathing room, so the reading order falls apart even though the headline stays dominant. B keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (eyebrow, headline, body, CTA, legal), but the headline sits in a left column while the body and CTA are centred on a different axis to the right. B also leaves the divider stranded at the right, the half-width dark band and empty upper right look unfinished, and its legal text is unreadably small. B is the less broken of the two.
